LESSON: RAISING THE WIDOW’S SON

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: Raising the Widow’s Son

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Raising the Widow’s Son
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to believe in the resurrection of the dead as a Christian?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ

Teach
• Today’s focus: model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ” using a school example.
• Model B for “model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Raising the Widow’s Son.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to believe in the resurrection of the dead as a Christian?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
